text.en:
Today you learn to ask questions.
Do you drive?
It means: are you someone who drives a car?
Does she drive?
It means: is she someone who drives?

Put Do or Does first.
With I, you, we and they, say Do.
Do you sell stamps?
With one other person or one thing, say Does.
Does the oven work?
Many things, like buses, take Do.
Do the buses run on Sundays?
The next word stays short: no s.

You will ask about home, work and shopping.
Look at who the question is about.
Then pick Do or Does.
Does your team start early?
Do we pay here?
